title: Mixed Event — Secret Distance — Episode5 The Last Haunted Place

meta.Event Outline: In hopes of pulling Kanade out of her songwriting slump, Mizuki plans a mystery tour for a much-needed change of pace. And so begins Nightcord at 25:00's first ever day trip together...

rows.Line: Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Um, MEIKO...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Why did you say those things the way you did?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The way I did...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You said, Please, act as if I'm not even here.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. If you'd like to learn more about everyone else, I think you should actually talk to them...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I see. I suppose that is an option...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But there are also things you become blind to by getting too close...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's why I'd like to maintain my distance and observe them for now.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Those three can freely enter and exit this SEKAI as well, even though it's made entirely out of Mafuyu's thoughts and feelings.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Those three must mean just that much to her. She can't be without them.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But those three each also have something on their minds, and I'd like to know what that could be.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Especially... Mizuki... I sense a great weight there...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But still, I just sort of got the feeling we were somehow alike.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That part that feels like we might be able to change ourselves a bit at a time to fit in with those around us, and the confusion at whether we should resist or accept it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Then getting so tired from trying so hard that nothing seems to matter anymore. I feel like we're similar in that.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: One time, Mizuki even mentioned to Mafuyu that, We were somehow alike...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Somehow alike...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Mizuki told Mafuyu that...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Mafuyu is usually silent around Miku, while Mizuki is the opposite with me and even tries to put ribbons in my hair and such.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'm not sure. Maybe I have a lot in common with them...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh...?
If that's the case then...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What's this weight I sense...?
Abandoned School

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Our last stop for the day is here♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Kanade! We're not going home until you have a solid idea for a song, okay?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, um... I'll try...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: This used to be a school...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yup. Apparently, the ghost of a dead student still haunts the music room.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: They say that she was so good, she competed in national competitions...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Everyone had such high hopes for her, but one day, she just buckled under the pressure and ended up dying.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Originally, this school was supposed to be demolished, but people ended up getting hurt when they intruded, so that idea got scrapped...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Again, you tell us these things at the worst times...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Aww, come on! We're on a haunted mystery tour, right? It's all in good fun...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: All those expectations...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Maybe this is what was best for her.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: She's alone and finally free now.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? Why do you say that?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Because it's so much easier that way...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Mafuyu...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
That hardly feels like something you should say while we're on a trip like this...
Hey, wait...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: She's heading for the school...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
M-Mafuyu, wait!
We've gotta go after her!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Ugh... Why does she always...?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hm? She's not here...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh? Really?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: She didn't go inside, did she?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: The doors are locked and I don't think there's an easy way in through the windows...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Mafuyu!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No response...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I'm gonna go look over there!
You two keep sending her messages and wait by the gate!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: H-Hey, Mizuki! Wait!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(She isn't here either...
What if she really went inside...?)
se_event_secret_2021_004

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But all the doors and windows are shut. I just have to hope that she's still out here somewhere.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Maybe this is what was best for her.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: She's alone and finally free now.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Because it's so much easier that way...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Mafuyu...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I doubt this'll work...
But it might be worth a shot...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Let's try there.
